note: Kaggle 2x T4 evaluations, 2026-11-18, that also scored this circuit. Splits: train, architecture, validation (design recordings only; held-out recordings never loaded). 'Trusted' rays recorded at least 1,024 photons and their full-recording sub-bin fit is within 3 bins of the reference lidar label. mae_m = mean error, recall_N_bins = share within N bins, over_1m = share more than 1 m off, moved_target_mae_m = mean error with every stream delayed by 300 bins.

v1-long-streams.what: rays with at least 4,096 recorded photons (at most 20,000 per split), 16 to 4,096 photons, 6 draws, target = reference lidar label

v2-all-recordings.what: every labelled ray (train capped at 60,000), 16 to 256 photons, 20 draws, target = reference lidar label

v3-long-streams-trusted.what: trusted rays with at least 4,096 recorded photons (train capped at 20,000), 16 to 4,096 photons, 6 draws, target = full-recording sub-bin fit

v4-all-recordings-trusted.what: every trusted ray (train capped at 60,000), 16 to 256 photons, 20 draws, target = full-recording sub-bin fit
